mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO magnet_v2_engine_session (resource_id, engine_session_id, state, owner_epoch, revision) VALUES (#{resourceId}, #{engineSessionId}, 'IDLE', 1, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT id, resource_id, engine_session_id, worker_id, state, active_task_id, owner_user_id, owner_epoch, resume_version, resume_key, revision, created_at, updated_at FROM magnet_v2_engine_session WHERE resource_id = #{resourceId}
mapper.update: UPDATE magnet_v2_engine_session SET state = #{state}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE resource_id = #{resourceId}
UPDATE magnet_v2_engine_session SET resume_version = #{version}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE resource_id = #{resourceId}

UPDATE magnet_v2_engine_session s JOIN magnet_v2_download_task t ON t.id = s.active_task_id SET s.active_task_id = NULL, s.owner_user_id = NULL, s.revision = s.revision + 1, s.updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE s.resource_id = #{resourceId} AND s.active_task_id = #{taskId} AND t.deleted = 0 AND t.status IN ('PAUSED', 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'DELETED')
